title: Carelink follower
symptom: The data source "Carelink follower" is not working, showing an error for 2 hours.
cause: The login URL (https://mdtlogin-ocl.medtronic.com:443/mmcl/auth/oauth/v2/token) responds to TLS ClientHello with an immediate TCP close, possibly due to blocking or outdated configuration. The discovery URL used by xDrip may be outdated; the Android app now uses a new discovery URL (v13) and Auth0SSOConfiguration pointing to carelink-login.minimed.eu.
evidence_quote: The login url (https://mdtlogin-ocl.medtronic.com:443/mmcl/auth/oauth/v2/token) currently responds to the TLS ClientHello with an TCP close immediately, maybe they block traffic without certain flags?
